correctness.rationale: TARGET route (research_report.claim_route=TARGET): audited against admitted target_claim verbatim. Re-ran inputs/artifacts/compute_interval.py: VERIFY_OK. Independently rechecked |HN|=273030912000000=2^14*3^6*5^6*7*11*19 (True); all 14 order*index=|G| asserted in-script and passed; S=sum 1/m_i=6979253/4266108000000~=1.6359766e-06 asserted and independently recomputed equal; L=1-S=4266101020747/4266108000000~=0.999998364023, U=1-1/1140000^2=1299599999999/1299600000000~=0.999999999999, width=S-1/m1^2~=1.6360e-06<0.05 and L>0.85 verified; outward 1e-9 rounding floor(L)/ceil(U)=[0.999998364,1.000000000] asserted to contain [L,U] and passed. Logic verified: (i) every non-generating pair lies in a maximal (finite-group maximal containment), each maximal is a conjugate of one of 14 reps; (ii) per-class union bound Q<=sum_i n_i/m_i^2 with n_i=[G:N_G(H_i)]<=m_i=[G:H_i] uses only H_i<=N_G(H_i), no self-normalizing assumption, and per-conjugate probability 1/m_i^2 is exact for uniform ordered pairs; (iii) fixed A12 conjugate gives Q>=1/1140000^2 since proper-subgroup pairs never generate. Transcription verified against archived snapshot and live ATLAS https://brauer.maths.qmul.ac.uk/Atlas/v3/spor/HN fetched 2026-09-11: all 14 (order,index) pairs match including two distinct M12:2 rows counted separately (correct for distinct G-classes). Completeness of the 14-class list is taken from the published Wilson et al. maximal-subgroup classification as represented by ATLAS, not re-proved in-script; order*index checks catch transcription error but not omission. That external-theorem reliance is logged as residual risk, standard for this admitted route.

General P2 machinery and asymptotic strong bounds do not mechanically imply the logged exact endpoints with rounding control; ATLAS stores order/maximals/representations but no P2(HN); (l,m,n)-generation and rank papers concern different invariants. See decisive_checks for adversarial checklist. Tool reported partial coverage (google query_index 1 'database is locked' after internal retries); recorded and mitigated by available SerpBase/Serpent+Crossref+OpenAlex results plus direct official ATLAS fetch. Title/embedding similarity alone did not establish coverage; hypotheses/conclusions compared literally.

value.rationale: TARGET claim is the admitted canonical global invariant: P2 of full HN, motivated before computation by the Liebeck-Shalev random-generation program, with stated downstream uses (product-replacement sampling, black-box timings, sporadic P2 tables). Exact interval [0.999998364,1.000000000] (exact rationals logged) of width ~1.64e-06 with L>0.85 was not known or stored and is not mechanically implied by general asymptotics; fresh summed 14-class ledger with rounding control was required. A future researcher can reasonably need this precise benchmark. Crude union bound is not a defect: smallest maximal index 1140000 makes it already far inside gates and yields strong substantive lower bound ~0.999998364. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration. Judged headline alone; no completed census demanded.
